channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Len Bias | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Len Bias from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Len Bias
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa on his viral video comparing himself to Len Bias:

“He got to his middy and I take huge pride getting to my middy... I started watching his film probably a couple months ago. I started pulling up his film on TikTok and I didn't know who he was.”

AJ Dybantsa on Len Bias, Jun 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Walt Williams on Michael Jordan, Len Bias
item.description:
Williams recently told Basketball Network.

“I think those guys certainly would have pushed each other to the max. The thing about Len Bias when you compare him to Michael Jordan, I think he was a little bit ahead of Michael when they were in college with his skillset.”

Walt Williams on Michael Jordan, Len Bias, Oct 3, 2021. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Walt Williams on Michael Jordan, Len Bias
item.description:
Walt Williams:

“I know certainly either we would have been talking about him(Bias) as the greatest of all time, or Jordan would be on an even different level. I think those guys certainly would have pushed each other to the max. The thing about Len Bias when you compare him to Michael Jordan, I think he was a little bit ahead of Michael when they were in college with his skillset.”

Walt Williams on Michael Jordan, Len Bias, Sep 28, 2021. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Monty Williams on Len Bias, John Thompson
item.description:
Williams, a Notre Dame graduate, said on Monday morning.

“He was a hero for us. We had our parents, and we had Len Bias, and Len died. And then we had John Thompson.”

Monty Williams on Len Bias, John Thompson, Aug 31, 2020. Source: ESPN.
